sentence: This project tries to find better ways to detect prostate cancer and assess its aggression using medical imaging data, histology data, and genetic data.
This project tries to find out how parents monitoring what their teens do reduces alcohol misuse and which parent behaviors matter.
This project provides leadership, coordination and statistical support across sites for a program studying aging, bone biology, adipose tissue biology and the neurosciences.
This project builds hydrogel-based wound dressings that deliver phage therapy to treat multidrug-resistant bacterial infections.
This project studies how human mesenchymal stem cells and their surroundings affect each other, using synthetic hydrogel scaffolds that mimic tissue.
This project tries to find out how the proteasome inhibitor carfilzomib causes vascular dysfunction, using single-cell RNA sequencing and CRISPR perturbation screens.
This project builds artificial intelligence tools that analyze heart and artery images plus clinical information to identify patients with coronary artery disease at high risk.
This project studies the mechanisms behind vascular disease in people with diabetes.
This project studies genetic regulatory mechanisms in Gram-positive bacteria that control expression of operons for biofilm exopolysaccharides and antibiotics.
This project studies how alternative promoters in cancer cells help support oncogene expression.
This project builds a photoacoustic and ultrasound imaging system with a hand-held probe that makes a 3D map of hidradenitis suppurativa in skin.
This project builds deep learning models and software tools that study how genetic and epigenetic changes contribute to Alzheimer's disease in single cells.
This project builds noninvasive imaging tools using optical coherence tomography and ultra-widefield fundus photography to measure retinal inflammation in noninfectious uveitis.
This project uses large health databases and blood biomarkers to measure how fast different organs age and how this affects cardiovascular health.
This project tries to find out how changes in 3D genome organization disrupt gene expression in human congenital heart defects.
This project provides antibody development, validation and production services, including nanobody generation from immunized alpacas, to support cancer research.
This project studies epigenetic mechanisms that may underlie alcohol use disorder, a chronic relapsing disease.
This project builds computer models of how cell membranes bend inward and outward during endocytosis and extracellular vesicle formation.
This project tries to find out how hematopoietic stem cells in the liver are controlled during extramedullary hematopoiesis.
This project builds models of metabolic interactions among microbial organisms in the human microbiome.
